What is the survival rate for Stage 3 rectal cancer?

text_blocks.snippet: The five-year survival rate for stage 3 rectal cancer is approximately 72%. This means that about 72 out of 100 people diagnosed with stage 3 rectal cancer are expected to live for at least 5 years after diagnosis. Stage 3 rectal cancer is characterized by the cancer spreading to nearby lymph nodes, but not to distant organs.
